structure: Single-grade Vermont draft framework document (Grade 8 - Civics and Economics in Action). Front matter: header banner, title/theme, Overview narrative, Looking Back/Looking Ahead, Inquiry rationale and contact. Inquiry Process block: 'Inquiry Process (K-12)' statement, a banded list of C3 indicators (6-8) and overarching grade themes. Body is organized by four subject sections (Civics, Economics, Geography, History), each with a 'Theme:' line, C3-strand headings (e.g. Civic and Political Institutions; Economic Decision Making; Geographic Representations; Change, Continuity, and Context) followed by the C3 indicator codes (D2.<Dim>.<n>.6-8). Each strand/indicator group is followed by a 2-column table (R1 headers 'Sample C3 Indicator Connections' | 'Sample Content Connections'; R2 cells hold C1 = 'Students will...' expectations, C2 = bulleted sample content). Rows continued over pages start with 'Continue'. Each subject ends with a 'Resources' list of suggested lessons/inquiries (C3 IDM, iCivics, PBS, etc.). The vermont.gov banner and running headers are furniture. No state-specific standard codes; the D2 C3 codes and the 'Students will' expectations are the standards. Labeling: titles/themes/strand headings/codes/inquiry indicators/'Students will' cells = standards; Sample Content Connections cells, Overview narrative and Resources = examples; Looking Back/Ahead, inquiry rationale, scope notes = backup.

issues: Inquiry Process / C3-indicator / Priority Performance Indicator lists that name a band (K-2, 3-5, 6-8) or K-12 are labeled with that band (shared inquiry skills); everything else is labeled with this file's single grade, per the state guide (one document = one grade).
Resource entries that wrap across pages are split into two units (second unit continues the first); both are labeled examples.
'Note:' lines saying an indicator is not addressed in this grade, and the 'Looking Back/Looking Ahead' paragraphs, are labeled backup.
u21-u23: 'Note: Free Civics Curricula' lists suggested free curricula before the Civics section; labeled examples.
u92: note says Economic Decision Making indicators are not in grade 8; labeled backup.
History tables are numbered T1/T2 on the same page (e.g. u144-u147 and u157-u160); handled by cell position.
u122, u165: 'Continue' prefix in C1 expectation cells; labeled standards.
u18: overarching themes list 'Geography (in grades 6 and 7)' although grade 8 has no Geography section; labeled grade 8 standards.
